Class PersistentLicenseCache

java.lang.Object
org.codehaus.mojo.license.download.PersistentLicenseCache
public class PersistentLicenseCache extends Object
A cache of downloaded license texts that outlives the build. One file per URL, named after the SHA-256 of the URL, holds a small header (URL, download time, content type, validators) followed by the bytes exactly as the server sent them. Because everything is in one file, replacing it with an atomic move is enough for builds that share the cache directory: a reader sees the old entry or the new one, never half of either.
Since:
2.8.0

    • PersistentLicenseCache

      public PersistentLicenseCache(Path directory, Duration timeToLive, boolean readEnabled)
      Parameters:
      directory - where the entries live; created on the first write
      timeToLive - how long an entry is served without asking the server
      readEnabled - when false, find(String) finds nothing, but store(String, byte[], String, String, String) still refreshes the entries
